summary.intent: Implement Task K: make `callisto init` translate a Changesets v2/v3 `.changeset/config.json` into `callisto.toml` (fixed groups, baseBranch, access refusal, reported ignored keys), following the lead's invariant-ladder rules, then push a PR linked to Entire trail #458.
summary.outcome: Implemented the migration in a new `init/changesets.rs` module with E342 for restricted/absent access, docs, spec criteria and a changeset. PR #596 was opened with a valid signed head commit. Reviewer findings on negated patterns and the spec exit code were addressed and the lead's cuts 1-3 were applied; the final refactor commit was made locally but not yet pushed, and CI and Entire findings were still pending.

repo: Init logic lives in callisto-graph `commands/init.rs` (facts, answers, render_config) and callisto-cli `commands/init.rs` (wiring, prompts); error codes are in `callisto-cli/src/error.rs`, with docs in `docs/errors.md` and spec criteria in `docs/specs/cli.json` (CLI-INIT-*).
Callisto publishes scoped npm packages lacking `publishConfig.access` as public (`npm_default_access` in `registry_argv.rs`), which is why Changesets `access` restricted/absent needs a guard.
`InitChangesetsAccess` (E342) sits in the `ExitKind::Usage` arm, which maps to exit 2, not 1. The spec text had to be corrected to match.

Changesets `fixed` patterns support `!` negation (picomatch/micromatch). globset has no leading `!`, so negation must be handled explicitly or excluded packages stay in the group and can trigger ConflictingGroupMembership.
Test helpers in `init/tests.rs` had to be made `pub(in crate::commands::init)` so the nested `changesets/tests.rs` module could reuse them.
Adding fields to `InitAnswers` or `InitPackage` requires updating every construction site in both crates' tests and the CLI.
`cargo mutants --in-place` mutates source files, so edits must wait until the run finishes. The mutants.out directory must not be committed.

code.finding: The `Key` enum with an `Other` catch-all added no exhaustiveness over matching `key.as_str()`, so it was removed in favor of string matching.
`publishes_public_by_default` compares the publish target with the literal "npm" instead of building a `PublishTarget::Npm{..}` just to call `config_str()`.

`baseBranch` always overrides the branch detected from origin, and `BranchName::from_full_ref` only checks non-empty. Values like `origin/main` or a stale `main` default on a `master` repo would produce a non-triggering workflow (reviewer finding 2, unaddressed).

workflow: The lead's instructions changed mid-task (skip `just ci` and the reviewer, run mutants only on new decision logic, push once touched-crate tests pass), so the process was adapted instead of finishing the original gate list.
Subagent and peer findings should be checked against the code before acting; the lead's cut 4 was rejected because the graph-only mutant on `Display::fmt` is not covered by CLI tests.
Long mutation runs (~30 min) block source edits when run with `--in-place`, so fixes must be sequenced after them.
`entire trail link` and `ci-pr` took several attempts to get the right arguments (`entire agent-help trail ...` was consulted).

friction: Entire trail link and ci-pr commands needed several attempts before the right argument forms were found.
Lead instructions changed repeatedly (full gates, then reduced ceremony, then changeset format, then cuts), forcing rework and re-running mutants.
The full-diff mutation run (~30 min) was stopped midway when the lead cut the ceremony.
The first `just pre-push` failed and the test helper (`INDEPENDENT` usage) had to be reworked to satisfy it.
`sed -i` differences on macOS (needing `''`) caused a failed first attempt at making test helpers pub.
`just test` was run repeatedly to isolate failures.
Several changeset-creation attempts failed before `add` accepted a placeholder summary that was then edited by hand.
open_items: The final refactor commit (string key match, duplicate assertion removal) is committed locally but not yet pushed to wip branch `wp-k-changesets-migration`, and the touched-crate tests and lint were run but CI was not re-checked.

Reviewer finding 2 (unvalidated `baseBranch`, such as `origin/main` or a `master` repo with default `main`, and the silent ignore in `run_workflow_only`) was a judgment call and appears unaddressed; it should be reported to the lead.
CI results for PR #596 and any Entire findings were still pending; findings that cause wrong results, broken recovery, security issues or unfailable checks must be fixed, the rest reported.
The final report to the lead (PR number, sha, gates run, anything not verified, under 5 lines) has not yet been sent.
`just ci` and the fresh reviewer were skipped on the lead's instruction, and the mutation run was re-run only on `changesets.rs`, so the PR body claim of zero missed mutants covers only that file.
Packages created after `init` must be added to `[[fixed-group]]` by hand, as documented in the user-facing changeset.
